# Emoji shortcodes :sparkles:

termd is fast :zap: and tested :white_check_mark:, and a long paragraph with :rocket: wraps at every width of the golden files like any other text :tada:.

- Tables :bar_chart:
- Diagrams :art:
- **Bold :fire:** and *italic :star:*

> [!WARNING]
> :warning: Shortcodes after a space are replaced.

| Feature | Status |
|---|---|
| Tables | :white_check_mark: |
| Diagrams | :warning: |
| Plugins | :x: |

See [the docs :book:](https://example.com/docs) and the footnote[^1]. Press <kbd>:arrow_up:</kbd> to scroll.

Term :one:
: Definition :two:

## Stays text

Glued: a:b:c, foo:rocket:bar, 1:zap:. Unknown: :octocat: and :not_an_emoji:.

Code `:zap:`, a bare URL https://example.com/:smile:/x and an image ![logo :star:](logo.png).

```sh
echo :zap:
```
